title: Add Conversation Calls subsection (audio/video calls) + voice-input modes
description: Conversation Mode (architecture.md ~80-90) is silent on the v2.1 call system. Add: global gate ttsSettings.callAudioEnabled (default false) + per-chat opt-in; character-initiated incoming calls; Discord-style desktop/mobile call surface, call-only chat, speaking highlights, mute/camera/screen-share, soundboard, minimized active-call popouts, call history cards, post-call summary injection. Voice input: callAudioInputMode = system|auto|transcribe|local_whisper (tts.ts:142, default local_whisper) = provider-native audio / manual dictation / browser speech / Local Whisper (downloadable Tiny/Base); callVideoInputEnabled (tts.ts:144, default false) gates camera/screen UI; callSttConnectionId/callSttModel deprecated.

title: API Surface: add /api/conversation-calls route family
description: Register /api/conversation-calls (routes/index.ts:89). Representative paths (conversation-calls.routes.ts): GET /chat/:chatId/status, POST /start, /:id/accept, /:id/decline, /:id/end, GET|POST /:id/messages, POST /:id/interruption, /:id/idle, /:id/media, soundboard CRUD (/soundboard, /soundboard/upload, /soundboard/:id/file, DELETE /soundboard/:id), and character/persona video-clip endpoints /character-videos/:id (+ /generate, /custom/generate, /file/:kind, /custom/:clipId/file) and /persona-videos/* mirror.

title: API Surface: add scene-video generation endpoints
description: Scene-video endpoints on gallery/game routes: POST /api/gallery/generate-scene-video (gallery.routes.ts:676; rejects connection whose provider!=='video_generation' at :707), GET /api/gallery/scene-videos/:chatId (:641), GET /api/gallery/scene-videos/file/:chatId/:filename (:653); parallel /api/game/scene-videos/* plus gameVideoConnectionId on setup (game.routes.ts:1080,5421).

title: Providers: add Video Generation provider category + services + 'Default for Videos'
description: CANONICAL video-provider entry (dedup across agents). Add a Video Generation provider distinct from LLM providers: video_generation (and image_generation) are in the APIProvider enum (connection.ts:19-20) but are NOT dispatched via the LLM provider-registry factory — handled by services/video/video-generation.ts. Five service profiles (VIDEO_DEFAULTS_SERVICES, video-generation-defaults.ts:17-23) + default models (video-generation.ts:43-47): Gemini Omni (gemini-omni-flash-preview), Google Veo (veo-3.1-generate-preview), xAI Imagine (grok-imagine-video-1.5), OpenRouter Video (google/veo-3.1, any OR video id), Seedance 2.0 (seedance-2-0). Video connections store per-service defaults under defaultParameters.videoGeneration and can be flagged 'Default for Videos' (chat fallback). Source of truth: docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md.

title: Providers: add TTS/voice provider note (xAI new in 2.1)
description: Skill has zero TTS coverage. Add a short TTS/voice provider note distinct from the LLM list: TTS provider union openai|elevenlabs|pockettts|xai (tts.ts:4); xai TTS added in 2.1 with built-in voice fallbacks (separate from the LLM 'xai'/Grok provider).

title: Advanced > Video Generation settings (keys/defaults/clamps + per-service profiles)
description: Settings key 'video-generation' (video-generation-settings.ts:7). Defaults: sceneVideoDurationSeconds=10, callCustomClipDurationSeconds=5, animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds=3, per-kind callClipDurations all 5s; clamps scene 1-60s, call 1-15s, animated-expr 1-8s. Per-service profiles (video-generation-defaults.ts:25-54): Gemini Omni 10s/16:9 (duration baked into prompt; rejects duration_seconds), Veo 8s/16:9/720p (accepts only 4/6/8s; forces 8s w/ image ref), xAI 10s/16:9/720p, OpenRouter 10s/16:9/720p, Seedance 5s/16:9/720p (opt-in temporaryPublicReferenceUploadEnabled + expiry 1h/12h/24h/72h, default 12h).

title: Video-gen env/config knobs (troubleshooting)
description: VIDEO_GEN_TIMEOUT_MS default 1_800_000 (30 min); poll intervals GOOGLE_VEO/XAI/OPENROUTER/SEEDANCE_VIDEO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (10/5/10/10s); first/last-frame refs need public HTTPS via VIDEO_REFERENCE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL or per-connection temp-upload; remote video download HTTPS-only, validated MP4 (video-generation.ts:41,61-64; docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:120-126,158-160).

title: Game Mode: scene video generation + storyboards
description: Game Mode (architecture.md:101-102) is v2.0-only. Add scene videos (dedicated Video Generation connection: chat.ts gameVideoConnectionId/sceneVideoConnectionId; MP4s -> scene-video store, appear in Gallery Videos tab; per-image Animate buttons, pinnable/draggable video overlays; also Roleplay + Visual Novel galleries). Add turn storyboards: split GM narration into 2-6 anchored keyframes (usually 4) via a Prompt Director, concurrent media render, draggable viewer, reopenable from Gallery, off-by-default Automatic Storyboard Animations; per-chat gameStoryboardAutoIllustrationsEnabled/gameStoryboardAutoGenerationEnabled (chat.ts:477-480); types game.ts:611-681; docs/STORYBOARD_ENGINE_GUIDE.md.

title: Game Mode media prompt presets (3 selectors + 5 built-ins)
description: Per-chat Game Mode media prompt presets: Illustration Prompt / Animation Prompt / Game Video Prompt selectors. Read-only built-ins: Still Keyframes, Comic Page, Colored Manga, B&W Manga (game-storyboard-prompts.ts:85-113) + Cinematic Scene Video (game-video-prompts.ts:31-34, default Game Video Prompt). Users get chat-local editable copies (chat.ts gameStoryboardIllustration/AnimationPromptTemplateId, gameStoryboardPromptTemplates, gameVideoPromptTemplateId/gameVideoPromptTemplates). Also note the game.video prompt-override key (renamed from game.omniVideo in 2.1; legacy still read as fallback).

title: Game Illustrator dynamic-prompt toggle
description: Optional Game Illustrator toggle for Dynamic LLM Prompt Generation: per-chat gameImageDynamicPromptEnabled (chat.ts:250-251) asks the chat/prompt LLM to rewrite Game Mode NPC portrait / location background / key-moment illustration prompts before image gen. Distinct from the post-processing 'illustrator' agent. Related: gameImageAutoGenerationEnabled (chat.ts:248), illustratorPromptConnectionId (chat.ts:238). UI: Chat Settings > Agents > Illustrator.

title: Document slash commands incl. /illustrate
description: /illustrate (alias /ill) in Conversation, Roleplay, Game chats triggers the same illustration action as the Gallery Illustrate button without opening the Gallery (slash-commands.ts:1044-1073; local:true; 30-min timeout ILLUSTRATE_SLASH_TIMEOUT_MS). Client slash commands are parsed in slash-commands.ts. Add /illustrate (+ /ill) as a user slash command available in all three modes.

title: Conversation reactions: [react:] incl. character-to-character + per-segment merged replies
description: CANONICAL reactions entry. Conversation-mode only (generate.routes.ts:3714; ignored elsewhere :10593). Grammar (character-commands.ts:386-394 REACT_RE): [react: emoji=".."], custom [react: emoji=":name:"], character-to-character [react: emoji=".. " to "Character Name"], also accepts [react: ".."]/[react: ..]. Posts a badge on target's most recent message; can target an individual character segment within a merged multi-character reply; a react to the user's persona name (or 'User') targets the user's latest message. Gated by a per-command 'Reactions' card toggle (setup wizard / Chat Settings). Merged-group attribution hardened (#3220).

title: Connections: folders + drag / custom sort order
description: Root-level connections can be reordered by drag or moved into folders via a saved Custom sort order (connection.ts sortOrder:number; connection-folders.ts sortOrder; #3295). One-line note; broaden the Connection definition to acknowledge media (image/video) connections too.

title: Special Features: in-app Documentation viewer
description: In-app documentation viewer (#3238): the docs/ guides are browsable inside Marinara via a 'Documentation' button in the home-page footer (next to Replay Tutorial), plus a FAQ entry showing the on-disk docs path. Lets support/ideation answers point users to bundled docs in-app.

title: Prompt-assembly 2.1 deltas (speaker labels, impersonate/guided precedence, attachments)
description: Fold into any prompt-assembly refresh: (a) 1:1 Conversation assistant turns now speaker-labeled with the character name in prompt history; (b) impersonate assembly — fallback presets drop conflicting non-marker sections while explicitly-selected impersonate presets keep normal sections (#3209); smart group order no longer overrides /guided or /impersonate (#3212); (c) readable text attachments no longer pre-truncated to 60,000 chars — bounded by the model's context window.

title: BUG: remove 'up to 3 visible' VN sprite-overlay cap
description: architecture.md:95 'VN-style character sprite overlays (up to 3 visible)' is now WRONG. The hard-coded three-sprite limit was removed from Roleplay sprite selection/setup/display (#3169). Drop the '(up to 3 visible)' qualifier; a chat can enable all uploaded sprite owners it needs.

title: Gallery 'Videos' rename + Images/Videos tabs (storage line)
description: Gallery 'clips' renamed 'Videos'; galleries hold images AND videos, split into Images/Videos tabs (character + persona), newest-first (the 'View latest' button was removed). Update the storage line (architecture.md:138 'gallery (generated images)') to include videos.

title: Add Sprites -> Clips (video-call presence clips) section + Character Video Presence
description: CANONICAL Sprites->Clips entry. character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (152-154) covers only VN expression sprites. Add a distinct 'Sprites -> Clips' section (Character AND Persona editors) for reusable video-call presence clips: six fixed kinds idle/talking/laughing/angry/crying/sighing (conversation-call.ts:10-26) + named custom clips capped at 128 (CUSTOM_CLIP_LIMIT, call-character-videos.service.ts:115); status missing|generating|ready|error, origin generated|uploaded; user-uploaded MP4 + non-destructive trimStartSeconds/trimEndSeconds; per-slot generation from empty/error cards; manifest ConversationCallCharacterVideoManifest (clips[]+customClips[]); served at GET /api/characters/:id/gallery/clips. PLUS Character Video Presence: callCharacterVideoEnabled (tts.ts:146, default false) uses the 'Default for Videos' connection to play cached avatar clips in-call from TTS cues, returning to idle; callAutomaticVideoClipsEnabled auto-generates min idle/talking.

title: Animated Expression Engine portrait sprites (video -> looping GIF)
description: character-cards.md:154 'automated sprite generation (uses image gen + a pose prompt)' is now incomplete. Expression portrait sprites can also be generated as short VIDEO clips via a Video Generation connection, converted to looping GIFs, saved into expression slots; Advanced > Video Generation controls duration (animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds default 3s, range 1-8) + prompt templates. Also relevant to agents.md 'expression' agent (post_processing, modeAllowlist roleplay/visual_novel).

title: Gallery Images/Videos tabs + video routes + MP4 upload endpoints
description: character-cards.md:174 lists only image gallery endpoints. Add video-gallery + clip endpoints (characters.routes.ts; persona mirror ~1823): GET /:id/gallery/videos/file/:filename, POST /:id/gallery/videos/upload, POST /:id/gallery/clips/upload, PATCH /:id/gallery/clips/:clipId/trim, DELETE /:id/gallery/clips/:clipId; note MP4 upload for gallery videos + Sprites->Clips, trim/delete, 128 custom-clip cap, bounded by CALL_VIDEO_CLIP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES.

title: In-call [react:]/[custom_clip] commands (engine-emitted, gated) + [custom_clip] real syntax
description: IMPORTANT syntax correction vs changelog prose. In call-only chat: hidden character command [custom_clip: label="short title", prompt="visual action/look"] (conversation-calls.routes.ts:736-740) — NOT bare [custom_clip]. Double-gated by callCharacterVideoEnabled && callCustomVideoClipsEnabled (tts.ts:150) plus an existing video connection (:1060); generated clip saved to that character's Sprites->Clips custom library (cap 128). Also in-call [react: emoji=".."]. Document where command grammar lives; note these are engine-emitted & gated, not user-authorable meta-commands or public custom tools.

title: Professor Mari structured preset creation + mari CLI
description: Mari section (character-cards.md:95-96) under-specifies preset creation. 2.1: Mari supports structured app_data preset.create/preset.update building prompt groups, sections, and preset variables/choice blocks in one reversible op (#3207). Contributor note: root pnpm mari -- --help wrapper exposes the built Mari CLI (#3208); flag parser fixed so boolean flags don't swallow positional args (#3222).

title: Autonomous-message accounting in merged groups (talkativeness note)
description: Low priority. character-cards.md:70 ties talkativeness to 'autonomous messaging rate'. 2.1: in merged group Conversation the SELECTED autonomous character receives the message attribution, follow-up count, and daily-budget count (not the first group member) (#3299). Optionally note per-character daily budget + follow-up accounting.

title: Document the Agent Suite window
description: Add under agents.md 'UI Location'. Agent Suite (#3160) in the Chat Settings drawer's Agents section: lists agents active in the current chat and lets you view/edit everything they store — agent memory, tracker state (Scene/Present Characters/Active Quests slices), and custom-agent outputs — manually OR via AI-assisted rewrites (select text or rewrite-all, give an instruction, an 'Add Context' grounding picker over character cards / active-lorebook entries max 20 sources/100k chars, and a connection). Reads/writes existing /api/agents/memory and /runs endpoints. Source: AgentSuiteModal.tsx.

title: BUG: soften 'force-pinned phase' claim — built-in phase overrides now persist
description: CONTRADICTS the v2.0 audit's fix (which had us mark Continuity/Prose Guardian as force-pinned post_processing). 2.1 (Fixed: 'agent pipeline phase overrides'): changing a built-in agent's phase in the agent editor is now honored in storage, normal generation, and manual retries instead of resetting to the built-in default — for Echo Chamber, Prose Guardian, Continuity, Immersive HTML, Expression, Music DJ. Qualify/soften any 'phase-locked/force-pinned' wording: user phase overrides on built-ins now persist and take effect.

title: Echo Chamber no longer fires on /continue
description: Add to the echo-chamber entry: Echo Chamber is now limited to fresh user messages and does NOT trigger on /continue continuation rewrites (2.1 Fixed). Source: echo-chamber/manifest.ts.

title: Roleplay/Game tracker field locks (lock survives rename/replace)
description: Trackers support locking individual fields; 2.1 hardened it so AI tracker updates can't bypass a locked field by renaming/replacing the locked row at the same position. Note wherever trackers are described that tracker/custom-agent update agents respect per-field locks.

title: Game Mode background: manual selection overrides GM auto-background
description: Add one sentence to the 'background' agent entry: a manually selected Game Mode chat background now overrides automatic GM scene-background selection until the user removes it (#3304) — mirrors the tracker field-lock 'manual pin wins' pattern.

title: NPC portrait generation grounded in live game state
description: Low priority / optional. GM-created NPC profile descriptions are rebuilt from current game state at asset-send time and sent as required canonical visual guidance for portrait prompts, preserved when generated avatars are written back to NPC metadata (2.1 Fixed). Note if the Game Mode section documents asset/portrait generation.

title: Document Regex Scripts (find/replace; character + preset scope)
description: DATE-CHECK: frame as 'surfaced/documented in the 2.1 doc refresh', not necessarily brand-new — intro version unconfirmed. Marinara ships a SillyTavern-style Regex Scripts system: find/replace transforms on prompts/output, scoped per-character (CharacterRegexSection.tsx) and per-preset (PresetsPanel.tsx); DB regexScripts (regex-scripts.ts) + seeded defaults (seed-regex.ts); apply hook use-apply-regex.ts. Source of truth docs/REGEX_SCRIPTS.md. Add a Regex Scripts subsection to custom-tools.md and an option in the decision-guide (SillyTavern-import-compatible).

title: Document Home Assistant integration (auto-generated webhook tools)
description: DATE-CHECK: integration may predate 2.1; the 2.1 change is docs/defaults (#... Fixed HA docs to current port, note WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true, re-sync updates existing tools). First-class Home Assistant integration generates webhook custom tools from HA entities and can re-sync them; because HA URLs are local plain-HTTP it REQUIRES WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED=true (SSRF gate). Add a short note to custom-tools.md citing docs/integrations/home-assistant.md.

title: Agent/tool lorebook writes no longer truncated
description: 2.1 removed the agent/tool write-path size cap on lorebook entry content — large entries written by save_lorebook_entry / Lorebook Keeper persist intact (no pre-storage truncation). Remove any implication that such entries are size-limited.

title: Video generation is now a native capability (not webhook-only)
description: decision-guide.md addresses only image generation and never video. Add: for 'can characters generate/animate video?', point to a Video Generation connection + the relevant surface (Gallery Animate / Game storyboards / animated expressions / call presence), NOT a webhook. Update any honesty-about-limits text that implies video is unsupported.

title: Version-string sweep: bump current-release/example/maturity 2.0 -> 2.1 (ONLY these 4)
description: Root is now 2.1.0 (package.json; android versionName 2.1.0/versionCode 29). The version-drift table (SKILL.md:417-430) already lists all 10 canonical files and matches scripts/versioning.mjs — NO table change. Bump ONLY: SKILL.md:137 'exist in 2.0 yet?'->2.1; SKILL.md:171 'on its 2.0 stable line'->2.1; SKILL.md:453 'does 2.0.x have feature X'->2.1.x; README.md:27 'exist in 2.0 yet?'->2.1. DO NOT touch the historically-accurate '(v2.0)' feature-introduction markers or 'removed in v2.0' notes in references/*.md.

title: Add references-routing rows for calls / video / new surfaces
description: SKILL.md 'When to consult bundled references' table (63-71) has no routing for the new surfaces. Add row(s): 'Conversation audio/video calls, character video presence, Sprites->Clips, video generation' -> architecture.md + character-cards.md; and note Professor Mari has built-in call-setup guidance. Optionally note video generation / regex scripts routing.
